## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase recognises an internally tiled, overview-bearing single-band GeoTIFF as COG-structured.

## Risk types covered

- [`dtype_drift`](../risk/dtype-drift.md)
- [`not_tiled`](../risk/not-tiled.md)
- [`overviews_missing`](../risk/overviews-missing.md)
